PROP-6a4369e9-inv-050.text: If the implementation caches the result of verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof, the cache key must include all three spec-defined inputs: (kzg_commitments, kzg_commitments_inclusion_proof, signed_block_header). Omitting any input from the cache key allows a sidecar with different commitments but matching proof and header to reuse a stale cached result, bypassing inclusion proof verification.
PROP-6a4369e9-inv-050.assertion: forall cache_hit(sidecar_a, sidecar_b): cached_result(sidecar_a) reused for sidecar_b => sidecar_a.kzg_commitments == sidecar_b.kzg_commitments AND sidecar_a.inclusion_proof == sidecar_b.inclusion_proof AND sidecar_a.signed_block_header == sidecar_b.signed_block_header

locations.note: Calls check_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof(data_column_sidecar). Nimbus calls this on every gossip validation without caching — the property may not be violated here. Phase 03 should verify whether any caching layer exists upstream.
Actual Merkle branch verification. No internal caching. This is the spec-defined verification function — audit should check all call sites for caching wrappers.
